messages:
Aisha - CSM: FYI post-onboard note: BetaCo saw a p95 latency spike and an uptime blip during the last week. Need to capture SLO gap, surface potential credit exposure, and surface renewal risk to AE teams.
Miguel - CS Ops: Got it. Which routes/endpoints are affected?
Aisha - CSM: Mostly /v1/generate for longer prompts; p95 climbed from 420ms -> 1.2s on Thu 3pm-5pm PST. Uptime incident was a 12-minute partial outage (region fallback).
Jared - Solutions Eng: I can check model routing logs and warmup config. Quick query I ran shows a spike in inferred sequence length for that workload.
Aisha - CSM: Thanks. Customer says onboarding docs didn't call out recommended batch sizes; they increased concurrency for tests.
Priya - RevOps: If we hit SLOs we may owe credits. Can we confirm whether contract uptime threshold (99.9%) was breached for their account window?
Miguel - CS Ops: Running account-scoped SLO check now. OnboardBot created incident support ticket #INC-8792.
OnboardBot: Ticket INC-8792 created and assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8792
Jared - Solutions Eng: Quick snippet to get per-account SLO violations:
```
SELECT
  account_id, count(*) as violations
FROM slo_violations
WHERE account_id = 'beta-co' AND ts >= '2026-03-14' AND ts < '2026-03-21'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
Jared - Solutions Eng: Ran that, returns 1 uptime violation and 7 latency violations in the onboard window.
Priya - RevOps: Ok that's actionable. Aisha, can you prepare a customer note with timeline + proposed credit calc? I can draft the credit table once we confirm minutes of downtime and percent below thresholds.
Aisha - CSM: Will do. Suggest we propose a one-off credit and an enablement session on batching/route pinning to avoid future spikes. Also recommending a warmup/coldstart guide be added to onboarding docs.
Miguel - CS Ops: Ops action items: (1) attach traces and Grafana panels to ticket, (2) validate fallback path behavior, (3) propose routing fallback to local model variant during region issues.
Jared - Solutions Eng: For the enablement session I can cover best-effort batching, prefix caching and model variant tradeoffs. Will prepare a 30m deck.
Aisha - CSM: I'll ping AE and set renewal-risk flag = "medium" until we close the remediation + credit convo. @Priya will approve credit formula.
Priya - RevOps: Thx. For transparency we should include a one-page SLO summary in the customer note: uptime window, latency p50/p95, incident timeline, credit calc. I'll attach a template.
Aisha - CSM: Draft action items for internal runbook: 1) Customer note by EOD tomorrow (Aisha), 2) Credit calc + approval (Priya), 3) Incident traces + runbook updates (Miguel), 4) Enablement session scheduled (Jared).
Miguel - CS Ops: I'll upload traces + Grafana links to INC-8792 and add runbook delta PR.
Jared - Solutions Eng: ETA for deck: 48 hours.
OnboardBot: Reminder set: follow-up in 3 days for status update on INC-8792.
Aisha - CSM: Great — will post the customer-facing summary here when ready and loop AE. :thumbsup:
Priya - RevOps: Marking renewal exposure note in CRM as 'monitoring' until credit delivered.
Aisha - CSM: Closing loop: once credits are approved we'll include a short feedback form and a checklist item in onboarding to capture whether customers followed the batching guidance.
Miguel - CS Ops: Agreed. That feedback will help reduce recurrence and will be added to the onboarding doc PR.
